Name: Vectorized Valley
Author: Shad9wGuy
Description:
[size=6][b]Vectorized Valley [/b][/size]

[b]Vectorized Valley [/b]makes all the in game textures smooth and higher resolution to make your gameplay much better! 

[size=5][b]How Does Vectorized Valley work?[/b][/size]

[b]Vectorized Valley [/b]runs the xBRZ (or xBR Your Choice) upscaling algorithm on the normal low resolution textures to make them much more smoother.

[size=5][b]Requirements [/b][/size]

SMAPI
Generic Mod Config Menu

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[url=https://sourceforge.net/projects/xbrz]xBRZ[/url] upscaling algorithm by zenju
Inspired from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4024?tab=posts]HD Sprites[/url]
